### What's new in v3.4.0

BCom now combines four new building blocks for embedded serial diagnostics:

- **A · Reliable capture** — bounded serial RX/TX binary recording to `.bcomcap` files, automatic 64 MiB rotation, queue-drop counters and JSONL replay (`BCom replay`). Recording runs separately from GUI rendering.
- **B · Quick Plot** — up to eight live numeric CSV channels per serial session, bounded 512-sample history, pause/resume, selectable 128/256/512-point windows and hover value inspection.
- **C · Protocol inspection and tests** — newline/fixed-size/length-prefixed framing, Modbus RTU CRC16, AT/Modbus/NMEA templates, offline capture decoding (`BCom decode`) and bounded declarative send/expect scripts (`BCom verify`).
- **D · Agent connectivity** — local stdio MCP server (`BCom mcp`) with read-only port discovery by default, explicit `--allow-write --port` authorization and metadata-only operation auditing.

The new functionality builds on **independent concurrent serial sessions** and the timestamped event timeline introduced after v3.3.0.

**Validation:** Windows x64, Linux x64, macOS x64 and macOS Apple Silicon builds; core regression tests and Linux pseudo-terminal integration tests. These automated checks do not replace sustained real-hardware UART testing.

**Limitations:** capture timestamps reflect read callbacks rather than exact byte/frame arrival; GUI capture can report dropped bytes when overloaded. MCP uses trusted local stdio clients without per-action approval dialogs. macOS DMG publication requires successful Developer ID notarization.
